recommendation_actions_taxonomy.RETAIN_WITH_EXPLICIT_POST_QUALIFICATION_: Retain the rule/threshold but explicitly reclassify its provenance as NEW_PREOUTCOME_ANALYSIS_DESIGN or POST_CANDIDATE_SELECTION_RULE.
recommendation_actions_taxonomy.REPLACE_WITH_PREEXISTING_JUSTIFIED_RULE: Replace draft wording with authoritative preexisting frozen rule or historical governance precedent.
recommendation_actions_taxonomy.MAKE_DESCRIPTIVE_NOT_GATE: Remove binary disqualification threshold; retain metric as continuous descriptive reporting endpoint.
recommendation_actions_taxonomy.REMOVE: Excise the rule or requirement entirely due to lack of justification or bias.
recommendation_actions_taxonomy.REQUIRE_EXTERNAL_JUSTIFICATION_BEFORE_FR: Retain as prespecified transfer/sensitivity benchmark, but require documented domain-specific justification before freeze.

item_recommendations.rule_or_threshold: MAE(test trajectory vs Phi(E/g)) <= 0.80 * MAE(test trajectory vs training per-energy mean baseline)

resolution_details.domain_justification: Requires 20% error reduction over constant per-energy population mean baseline on unseen scaffolds. Accounts for real-data noise by reporting full MAE ratio distribution (mean, median, IQR, 95% bootstrap interval) alongside binary gate.

item_recommendations.rule_or_threshold: Lower bound of 95% Wilson interval for Competence Rate >= 0.70 (evaluated in conjunction with 2000-resample scaffold bootstrap)

resolution_details.domain_justification: Maintains 70% competence standard under conservative binomial uncertainty, accompanied by dual reporting of 2000-resample scaffold bootstrap intervals and descriptive reporting across competence threshold grid [0.50, 0.90].

item_recommendations.rule_or_threshold: Median pairwise Spearman correlation of log(g) across K=5 scaffold-disjoint training subsamples >= 0.80
item_recommendations.synthetic_origin: Gate G1 rank-recovery threshold repurposed into subsampling stability (c40a184 / db70d6d)

resolution_details.domain_justification: Verifies that profile scale estimation is not pathologically dependent on specific scaffold subsets. Reclassified from model falsification to parameter identifiability check.

item_recommendations.rule_or_threshold: Upper 95% bound of optimizer boundary hit rate <= 0.20 on both scaffold-bootstrap and Wilson intervals

resolution_details.domain_justification: Ensures scale parameter g is not accumulating at artificial numerical profile search boundaries [g_min, g_max] in > 20% of compounds.

item_recommendations.rule_or_threshold: Declared precursor m/z within 5 ppm of trajectory median declared precursor m/z across all records (Rule T10, Gate I6)

resolution_details.domain_justification: Accommodates 0.001-0.003 Da display rounding in public repository exports while strictly rejecting precursor misannotations.

item_recommendations.rule_or_threshold: >= 200 scaffold groups surviving input integrity (S1 Attrition Floor)

resolution_details.domain_justification: Ensures scaffold-disjoint 60/20/20 splitting retains >= 25-40 independent clusters in the test fold, preventing asymptotic collapse of cluster-bootstrap variance estimators.

item_recommendations.rule_or_threshold: Median within-compound range of min m/z across NCE > 20 Da OR within-compound |Spearman(min m/z, NCE)| >= 0.30 triggers INCONCLUSIVE

resolution_details.domain_justification: Prevents dynamic instrument scan-range shifts from creating an artificial energy-dependent mass trend masquerading as fragmentation.

item_recommendations.rule_or_threshold: Fraction of spectra with min m/z / precursor_mz > 0.25 exceeding 20% triggers INCONCLUSIVE

resolution_details.domain_justification: Prevents mass-proportional low-mass cutoff from artificially pre-loading collinearity between fragment mass moment mu and precursor mass.

item_recommendations.rule_or_threshold: Median |mu - mu^(c)| > 0.02 OR within-energy Spearman(mu, mu^(c)) < 0.95 at any CE triggers INCONCLUSIVE (c = 95th percentile min m/z)

resolution_details.domain_justification: Explicitly calibrated against historical LCSB dynamic range (delta-mu ~ 0.44; 0.02 is < 5% of signal span) to verify mathematical invariance of the fragment moment.

item_recommendations.rule_or_threshold: Minimum 3 peaks per spectrum (Gate I9); > 5% spectra with < 3 peaks triggers U4 INCONCLUSIVE

resolution_details.domain_justification: Minimum centroid count required to compute a non-degenerate intensity-weighted first mass moment mu.

item_recommendations.rule_or_threshold: 2,000 bootstrap resamples for clustered percentile intervals and null threshold calibration

resolution_details.domain_justification: Standard Monte Carlo practice ensuring standard error on 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles remains below 0.5%. Lineage tied to Phase 2 PREREGISTRATION.md and Type 2 protocol.

item_recommendations.rule_or_threshold: Promote [M+H]+ if present and qualifying; otherwise lexicographically first qualifying adduct string (Rule T6)

resolution_details.domain_justification: Eliminates adduct-level pseudoreplication while enforcing a fully deterministic, reproducible tie-breaker aligned with historical [M+H]+ focus.

item_recommendations.rule_or_threshold: Representative structure chosen as lexicographically first deposited SMILES (T8); duplicate records resolved by lexicographically smallest accession (T7)

resolution_details.domain_justification: Automated, deterministic rules eliminating subjective curation or researcher cherry-picking.

item_recommendations.rule_or_threshold: WFSR Food Safety Mass Spectral Library selected as Primary External Validation Dataset

resolution_details.domain_justification: Largest scale (957 groups), Orbitrap IQ-X HCD NCE % match, 100% Level 1 standards, and open licensing. Subject to mandatory co-primary reporting of clean 766-compound non-overlapping subset.

item_recommendations.rule_or_threshold: Priority ranking: Primary = WFSR, Backup 1 = BAFG (CSL, N=666), Backup 2 = Athens_Univ (N=544), Supplementary = Eawag (N=326)

resolution_details.domain_justification: Transparently orders evaluation sequence on pre-outcome scale, CE depth (15 voltages in BAFG), multi-injection variance (Athens), and licensing.

item_recommendations.rule_or_threshold: Criteria B1-B5 for Structure Beyond Mass; Nulls N1-N4 (200 worlds each); within-compound energy permutation prohibited

resolution_details.domain_justification: Directly incorporates Type 2 empirical validation learnings: prohibits trajectory-destroying within-compound energy permutation, scales null worlds to 200, and adds mass-preserving null N4 to decouple descriptor associations from molecular mass.

item_recommendations.rule_or_threshold: <= 20% overlap: CHEMICALLY_INDEPENDENT; 20-50%: PARTIAL_CHEMICAL_OVERLAP; > 50%: NOT_CHEMICALLY_INDEPENDENT

resolution_details.domain_justification: Authoritative frozen criterion established before candidate search at commit 705adf8.

item_recommendations.rule_or_threshold: >= 250 qualifying compound groups in a single ionization mode (Hard Floor)

resolution_details.domain_justification: Master Plan Section 22 Kill Criterion K1 frozen at commit 62ce5e9. Enforces minimum sample size for 60/20/20 test fold power.

item_recommendations.rule_or_threshold: >= 400 qualifying groups (Comfortable Scale in E5); >= 400 complete trajectories surviving S1 (Attrition Floor)

resolution_details.domain_justification: Comfortable size from Master Plan Section 20; attrition floor ensures post-filtering evaluation operates on statistically powered dataset.

item_recommendations.rule_or_threshold: Train 60% / Validation 20% / Test 20%, scaffold-disjoint, size-balanced on compound counts

resolution_details.domain_justification: Standard project convention balancing training profile estimation power with independent validation model selection and uncompromised single-shot test scoring.

item_recommendations.rule_or_threshold: Seed 20260813 for deterministic split assignment and subsampling

resolution_details.domain_justification: Prospectively fixed pseudorandom seed generated from protocol freeze date before any outcome calculation.
